description: This Java class defines a set of enumerations related to account transfer operations within the Apache Fineract project. It provides static methods to convert integer or domain enum values into EnumOptionData instances with meaningful labels, supporting UI or API representations.

classes.name: AccountTransferEnumerations
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods to convert different account transfer-related enums and types into EnumOptionData for API or UI display.

methods.name: accountType
methods.description: Converts an integer or PortfolioAccountType enum to an EnumOptionData with a human-readable label for account type.

methods.name: recurrenceType
methods.description: Converts an integer or AccountTransferRecurrenceType enum to an EnumOptionData with a label for recurrence type.

methods.name: transferType
methods.description: Converts an integer or AccountTransferType enum to an EnumOptionData with a label for transfer type.

methods.name: standingInstructionPriority
methods.description: Converts an integer or StandingInstructionPriority enum to an EnumOptionData with a label for instruction priority.

methods.name: standingInstructionStatus
methods.description: Converts an integer or StandingInstructionStatus enum to an EnumOptionData with a label for instruction status.

methods.name: standingInstructionType
methods.description: Converts an integer or StandingInstructionType enum to an EnumOptionData with a label for instruction type.
